method: meshy text-to-image (nano-banana-pro, one 3x2 sheet on black) + local brightness-alpha cut

credits_per_call.why: repeatability test, same prompt: came back on WHITE

notes.worked: One 9-credit pro call gave all six in a consistent, polished mobile-VFX style on true black (black point 3/255), well separated, no text. Brightness alpha + un-premultiply gives clean edges on both strips, no dark fringe. Glowing sprites (flame, droplet, bolt, star, wisp) cut perfectly with auto gain ~1.0.
notes.needed_a_tweak: leaf is a solid, non-emissive shape (dark-green outline, mid-green body), so brightness alpha made it see-through; --gain leaf=3 makes it opaque. Grey versions get a gamma so the body's median is ~0.78 grey, otherwise a green/blue body desaturates to dark grey and tints dark.
notes.failed: Repeatability: the SAME prompt on a second pro roll ignored 'pure solid black background' and drew all six on white with dark outlines -> unusable for a brightness cut (sheet_cut.py now refuses a sheet whose background black point is > 0.2). Expect roughly 1 in 2 rolls to need a re-roll; check the sheet before cutting. nano-banana (3 cr) also works on black but is less on-brief: the star comes with satellite sparkles, the wisp is a round grape-like cloud, a stray white blob sits in the top-left corner, and the flame cuts small.

per_sprite.flame: good: clean tongue, white core, orange glow; tintable grey keeps the core/body split
per_sprite.droplet: good: glossy highlights, blue rim glow, reads well small
per_sprite.leaf: good silhouette with midrib; has a drawn dark outline (cartoon, not glow) - most 'icon-like' of the six
per_sprite.bolt: good: bright white core, yellow glow; slightly thin at 20 px
per_sprite.star: very good: clean 4-point twinkle with soft halo
per_sprite.wisp: good: curling smoke with soft edges; the pro version is the only one that reads as a wisp

notes.adding_a_new_sprite: Cheap but not style-locked: a new text-to-image call (3-9 credits, ~20-40 s) redraws the whole set, so a single new sprite may drift from the six. Better: ask for a new sheet containing the new sprite plus 1-2 existing ones as style anchors, or use image-to-image on this sheet (not tried). Cutting is one command.
